overview:
Sarah Elfreth enters the general election as a heavy favorite in a district that leaned about twelve points Democratic at the presidential level. Running as an incumbent after clearing her primary, she has raised roughly $1.4 million, while Republican Berney Flowers has raised about $31,000 and had under $6,000 on hand. Prediction markets price her chances near 96 percent.

No public general-election polls are available, so the outlook rests on district fundamentals, the money gap, and market pricing, all of which point the same way: a Democratic margin in the low twenties. A midterm turnout environment could narrow the margin somewhat, but the combination of partisanship, incumbency, and resources makes an upset very unlikely. The race is rated Safe Democratic.
